correctness.rationale: For K_{a,b} minus t disjoint edges with a,b≥3, induced max-degree≤1 directly permits single-shore faces, ab cross pairs, t(a+b-2) triples and binom(t,2) four-faces. Inclusion-maximal faces are both shores, (a-t)(b-t) unmatched edges, t(a+b-2t) mixed triples and binom(t,2) fours. Contracting both shore simplices produces a suspension of a square complex whose main component reduces to K_t, with (a-t)(b-t) isolated vertices, proving the integral wedge of that many S1 and binom(t-1,2) S2 for t≥1 and ab-1 S1 for t=0. Independent original-degree enumeration and mod-2 Betti checks at (4,4,3),(4,5,2),(3,3,0),(4,4,4) agree, but integral/all-size conclusion rests on CW homotopy proof, not F2 computation.
